ratchet_prerequisites: separate Catylist and AES policy decision
policy.third_party_policy: Inventory external references and mirrors, but do not impose project-owned policy changes.

repositories.rationale: The current implementation crosses Swift 6 and C, owns SQLCipher key material, imports encrypted catalogues, and supports Linux/ELF plus Apple/Mach-O targets.

The implemented foundation is a C++ process bridge with no safe-language FFI, key lifecycle, or encrypted store. Planned M1 scene bridge packages may carry confidential production data, so applicability must be reassessed when translation and staging land.
repositories.classification_trigger: M1 scene import/export or any persisted bridge package

repositories.rationale: Application architecture, language boundaries, secret material, and confidential local-storage behavior have not yet been inventoried against AES-SEC-002.
repositories.classification_trigger: documented application boundary and storage inventory

repositories.rationale: AEMS currently consists of Python reporting tools and documentation; it has no memory-safe/native ABI, secret lifecycle, or confidential encrypted local store.
Catylist is governance and schema tooling without a safe/native ABI, secret lifecycle, or confidential encrypted local store.
AES owns the standard but does not currently implement an application boundary covered by it.
P0 currently contains bootstrap documentation and no covered ABI, secret, or encrypted-storage boundary.
Repository templates may distribute future controls but do not themselves implement a covered application boundary.
Current Atarix code is native C/RTL without a memory-safe-language FFI, application secret lifecycle, or encrypted confidential local store; AES-SEC-001 remains applicable.
EVO is a native library with no currently declared safe/native ABI consumer, secret lifecycle, or encrypted store.
Experimental native programs are covered by AES-SEC-001; no AES-SEC-002 boundary is currently declared.
The documentation toolchain has no declared safe/native ABI, secret lifecycle, or encrypted confidential local store.
The publication project has no declared safe/native ABI, secret lifecycle, or encrypted confidential local store.
The administrative repository has no covered application implementation.
No safe/native ABI, secret lifecycle, or confidential encrypted local store is declared in the current demo.
External/reference processor material is not a Catalyst-owned application boundary.
External/reference hardware material is not a Catalyst-owned application boundary.
External/reference FPGA material is not a Catalyst-owned application boundary.
External/reference system material is not a Catalyst-owned application boundary.
A third-party C-library mirror is not rewritten as a Catalyst application boundary.
A third-party emulator mirror is not rewritten as a Catalyst application boundary.
